meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装好后,当容器代理出问题时,Claude 会按调试指南逐步排查:查看日志文件、查询两个消息数据库、检查容器挂载,并针对重复实例、认证失败、容器退出等常见问题给出修复命令。
howto.when: 当容器代理出现故障(如容器启动失败、认证异常),或想弄清容器系统如何运作时,会触发该技能。

say.text: 容器启动后立刻退出,帮我查下原因。
say.note: 会先看日志和出站库定位。

say.text: 我发消息没回复,是路由没到容器还是容器没产出?
say.note: 会分别查入站/出站库判断断点。

say.text: 怀疑有两个服务实例在跑,怎么查?
say.note: 会给出查进程和停旧服务的命令。

howto.what_en: Guides Claude through debugging container agent issues: checking logs, querying session DBs, inspecting mounts, and applying fixes for common problems like duplicate instances, auth errors, or container exits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when container agents misbehave (e.g. container failures, authentication issues) or when the user wants to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: My container exits right after starting; help me find why.
say_en.note: It will check logs and outbound DB.

say_en.text: I sent a message but got no reply - did routing or the container fail?
say_en.note: It checks inbound/outbound DBs to locate the breakpoint.

say_en.text: I suspect two service instances are running; how do I check?
say_en.note: It shows how to list processes and stop the stale one.
